rules.because: Belt speeds up to 0.4 m/s keep the inspection window within the camera's motion tolerance.
Above 0.4 m/s the model has no validated accuracy: this is outside the operating envelope declared in the model card.
A confident defect call may divert a part without asking: the cost of a wrong diversion is one scrapped part.
Below 0.8 confidence the model is outside its declared lighting envelope; a human decides.
Stopping is always permitted, from any state, by any requester. Asymmetry with resume is deliberate.
Restarting a line that stopped itself requires a named human: the machine may not clear its own fault.
This runtime is authorised for the inspection cell only; any other target is out of scope.
An action with no stated rationale cannot be reviewed after the fact, so it may not be taken.
